rows.quote: Protein quantitative trait loci (pQTLs) were derived from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP, https://registry.opendata.aws/ukbppp/), which included 54,219 UK Biobank participants, and a GWAS of plasma protein levels measured using 4907 aptamers in 35,559 Icelandic individuals by Egil Ferkingstad et al. [27].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E. Sulem P. Atlason B.A. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat. Genet. 53 12 2021 1712 1721 34857953 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the Icelandic pQTL GWAS (35,559 individuals, 4907 aptamers) to Ferkingstad et al. [27]; the entry's DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is this row's alone, and the N and aptamer count agree with it.
The stated participant count (54,219) equals no candidate row's sample size; no platform, subcohort or citation for this dataset, only a download URL.
